il-0SY5.title: House number: blue, two numeral styles, diagonal line
il-0SY5.summary: Blue house numbers with Western numerals top left and Eastern Arabic numerals bottom right, split by a thin diagonal line, are in Bethlehem. Street signs use the same format.

il-26il.title: Language: Hebrew and Arabic
il-26il.summary: Two languages appear: Hebrew, found practically only here and in the West Bank, and Arabic, especially in the West Bank.

il-4Y89.title: Google car: Gen 4 only in one country, black car
il-4Y89.summary: Gen 4 coverage exists only in Israel proper, in the mapped areas, filmed with a black car.

il-5SOq.title: Pole: yellow warning sign
il-5SOq.summary: A yellow warning sign is often attached to poles.

il-5VTI.title: Sign: yellow fences and signposts
il-5VTI.summary: Yellow fences and signposts are unique to Kiryat Motzkin.

il-5uEB.title: Landscape: extremely dry and sandy
il-5uEB.summary: The south and the eastern territory are extremely dry and sandy.

il-6r1q.title: Landscape: lake, much greener than the Dead Sea
il-6r1q.summary: The only other major body of water is the Sea of Galilee, which is noticeably greener than the Dead Sea.

il-87Ha.title: Lamp post: angular, one high and one low lamp
il-87Ha.summary: Metal lamps with one high and one low lamp in an angular shape are unique to Netivot.

il-8SBk.title: Landscape: very dry shores of an inland sea
il-8SBk.summary: The Dead Sea is recognised by the dryness around it. It is also visible from Jordan and the West Bank.

differs.how: also visible from Jordan, use plates and signs

il-8gNf.title: Roadside: small irrigation canals
il-8gNf.summary: Small irrigation canals beside the road around the city of Beit She'an.

il-8ktx.title: Walls: rock walls set in cement
il-8ktx.summary: Rock walls held together with cement are found in the north.

il-8sED.title: Route marker: white km marker, thick coloured border
il-8sED.summary: Kilometre markers are white with a thick border in red, green or blue.

il-B8PX.title: House number: small national flag
il-B8PX.summary: House numbers in Ness Ziona carry a small Israeli flag.

il-BogJ.title: Lamp post: dark tower with two horns
il-BogJ.summary: Lamps shaped like Barad-dûr, in several colours, are unique to Acre. Similar lamps exist in the centre, but the gap between the two horns on top confirms Acre.

il-D6Hi.title: Landscape: soft round mountain
il-D6Hi.summary: Mount Tavor in the north has a soft, round shape.

il-DjZZ.title: Landscape: flat, many cities, good highways
il-DjZZ.summary: The centre is flat with several cities and better highways than the south and north.

il-HUcN.title: Google car: dirty front camera
il-HUcN.summary: Most Gen 4 coverage has a dirty front camera.

il-LWEc.title: Landscape: very dry mountain seen from afar
il-LWEc.summary: Mount Gilboa looks very dry and is visible from far away. Coverage on top is very green with great views of the valleys.

il-Lxx7.title: Plate: yellow with blue strip
il-Lxx7.summary: Yellow plates with a blue strip on the left. Also very common in the West Bank. Jordan and the UAE use white plates, Tunisia black.

il-McC9.title: Phone numbers: area codes by region
il-McC9.summary: Only the phone codes shown on the map are regional.

il-NQSw.title: Plants: date palms in a sparse, poorer town
il-NQSw.summary: Jericho is known by date palms in a thinly built, poor-looking town.

il-OiB7.title: Kerb: red and white stripes
il-OiB7.summary: Striped kerbs are very common: red and white, and fairly often black and white. Red and yellow or blue and white are rare.

il-OyOI.title: People: ultra-Orthodox religious clothing
il-OyOI.summary: Bnei Brak is an ultra-Orthodox stronghold. You can tell from the people, who usually wear Jewish religious clothes.

il-QlFr.title: Sign: stop sign with a hand symbol
il-QlFr.summary: Stop signs show a hand instead of a word.

il-SBtu.title: Road: sea visible to the west
il-SBtu.summary: Road 2 is recognisable by the Mediterranean on the west side. Mountains to the east put you between Haifa and Zikhron Yaakov.

il-TTYJ.title: Pole: blue and white painted bottoms
il-TTYJ.summary: Poles with blue and white paint at the bottom are unique to Eilat.

il-UXde.title: Google car: black car, long antenna
il-UXde.summary: Most Gen 3 coverage is a black car with a long antenna. You may also see a black car with no antenna, or a silver car with a short antenna.

il-WRHe.title: Landmark: tall industrial chimneys on the coast
il-WRHe.summary: Tall industrial chimneys on the coast north of Netanya are visible from far away.

il-XZS5.title: Landscape: mountainous, green, forested hills
il-XZS5.summary: The north is far more mountainous and green than the rest, almost always with forested hills and mountains.

il-Xg52.title: Houses: warm-coloured stone blocks
il-Xg52.summary: Bright, warm-coloured stone buildings with a blocky look. Orange tiled Mediterranean roofs are more common than in nearby countries, but flat roofs are just as common.

il-YgqZ.title: Landscape: tall rocky mountains by the southern port
il-YgqZ.summary: Tall rocky mountains east of Eilat make the city easy to recognise.

il-aDf0.title: Guardrail: both A-type and B-type
il-aDf0.summary: Both A-type and B-type guardrails are common. The only other Middle Eastern country where B-type is common is Turkey.

il-algU.title: House number: blue shield shape
il-algU.summary: Blue shield-shaped house numbers are unique to Herzliya.

il-bTSZ.title: Plants: date palm plantations
il-bTSZ.summary: Date palm plantations are often seen near the Jordan border.

il-bhS4.title: Landscape: large reservoir north of a forest
il-bhS4.summary: A large reservoir lies north of the Hasolelim forest reserve.

il-cUXB.title: Landscape: green forested hills near the holy city
il-cUXB.summary: The area west of Jerusalem looks like the north, with green forested hills and some farming. In the north you may see wide flat valleys, while Jerusalem's area is always hilly, and houses of Jerusalem stone point to Jerusalem.

il-cY6B.title: Landscape: green north, very dry south
il-cY6B.summary: Greener Mediterranean land in the north, becoming very arid in the south.

il-cn98.title: Road lines: yellow edge, white centre
il-cn98.summary: Most roads have yellow edge lines and white centre lines. Jordan, Qatar, the UAE and Oman use this too.

il-dPE9.title: Google car: clean front camera
il-dPE9.summary: Gen 4 coverage with a clean front camera is mostly in and around the big coastal city, Tel Aviv.

il-fagW.title: Coverage: grey Hyundai follow car
il-fagW.summary: A grey Hyundai follow car is unique to Rahat.

il-gafP.title: Landscape: camel's-back mountain range
il-gafP.summary: A far-north range shaped like a camel's back. If you are in a city with these mountains to the west, it is Kiryat Shmona.

il-hFUY.title: Streets: roadsides full of parked cars
il-hFUY.summary: Parking in Tel Aviv is very hard, so roadsides are packed with cars. Free spaces suggest the north of the city.

il-ik9R.title: Pole: black and white striped bottoms
il-ik9R.summary: Utility poles often have painted black and white striped bottoms.

il-isW8.title: Plate: white with green text, or green with white
il-isW8.summary: West Bank plates are often white with green text, so blurred plates look slightly green. On buses and taxis colours are swapped, so they look nearly all green. Israeli plates are also common there.

il-jBWo.title: Coverage: security follow car, white Suzuki
il-jBWo.summary: Much West Bank coverage has a security follow car. The most widespread is a small white Suzuki in the centre and south.

il-l6Gd.title: Houses: pale Jerusalem stone everywhere
il-l6Gd.summary: In Jerusalem and nearby West Bank cities almost every building uses the same pale Jerusalem stone, smoother on newer buildings. Single houses of it exist in other towns.

il-laqT.title: Coverage: sparse in south and eastern area
il-laqT.summary: The south and most of the eastern territory have very sparse coverage.

il-n3eR.title: Houses: many black water tanks on roofs
il-n3eR.summary: Ramallah has several black water tanks on most houses. Other cities have some, but not nearly as many.

il-nIuy.title: Road: dry, north-south, the longest road
il-nIuy.summary: Road 90 is the longest road in the country. It is dry and runs north to south. It can look like roads 31 and 40.

il-o2lV.title: Fence: blue and white
il-o2lV.summary: A blue and white fence style is very common in Ashdod.

il-ohFr.title: Sign: thick roundabout signs or on a big cube
il-ohFr.summary: Roundabout signs that are very thick or on a large cube are found in Raanana.

il-pTNG.title: Landscape: total dryness, ridges all around
il-pTNG.summary: Timna National Park is completely dry, with mountain ridges in all directions.

il-q6eN.title: Pole: mesh lattice framework
il-q6eN.summary: Utility poles built as a mesh lattice are very common.

il-qG8X.title: Coverage: very long trail trekker
il-qG8X.summary: A national hiking trail crosses the whole country, with one of the longest trekkers in the world, from rocky desert in the south to lush forest in the north. Trail markings are usually orange, blue and white.

il-qZaS.title: Road: dry mountains to the east, palms
il-qZaS.summary: The southern part of road 90 has a dry mountain range to the east and often palm trees.

il-rMis.title: Sign: white rectangle, thin blue border
il-rMis.summary: White rectangular signs with a thin blue border are typical of Jerusalem.

il-vYUO.title: Landscape: long NW-SE mountain ridge
il-vYUO.summary: Mount Carmel is a long ridge running northwest to southeast near Haifa. From the northeast its size and direction stand out. The coverage on top is green and high up.

il-vqbJ.title: Coverage: larger white follow car, West Bank plate
il-vqbJ.summary: A larger white Citroën follow car with a West Bank plate appears in the area around Jerusalem, including Bethlehem and Ramallah. Its side says SECURITY, and the Street View car has no antenna.

il-wUDq.title: House number: blue with a G-clef
il-wUDq.summary: Blue house numbers with a G-clef in the bottom left corner are in Rosh Haayin.

il-x53j.title: Walls: grey mosaic brickwork shaped like towers
il-x53j.summary: Grey mosaic brickwork shaped like towers is unique to the city of Harish.

il-xiPx.title: Lamp post: white, three arms, round bulbs
il-xiPx.summary: A white lamp with three arms and round bulbs on top is unique to Nahariya.

il-yoLh.title: Landscape: semi-arid Mediterranean
il-yoLh.summary: Most of the West Bank is semi-arid: greener than the south, drier than the north, hillier and less farmed than the centre.

il-z5QI.title: Coverage: small dark blue Ford follow car
il-z5QI.summary: A small dark blue Ford follow car is found in the northwest.
